paite: "Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen; Pathian na gingta ua, kei leng hon gingta sam un.
heading: Pa Kiang Zotna Lampi
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

paite: Ka Pa inn ah tenna mun tampi a-om; a-om lou hileh, ka hon hilhta ding hi; noute a dia mun bawl ding a kuan dek ka hi.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

paite: Huan nou a dia mun bawl ding a ka kuanleh ka hong kik nawn ding a, ka kiang ah nou ka hon la ding, ka omna a nou leng na om theih samna ding un.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

paite: Ka hohna ding alampi na thei uh," achi hi.
english: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

paite: Thomas in akiang ah, "Toupa, koi a hoh ding na hia ka thei kei uh, alampi bang ka chi theih ding ua?" achi hi.
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Keimah tuh huai lampi, huai thutak leh huai hinna ka hi; keimah a pai lou kuamah Pa kiang atung kei," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

paite: "Kei na hon theih khit uleh ka Pa leng na thei khinta ding uh; tu a kipan amah na thei ua muh leng na muta uhi," achi hi.
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

paite: Philip in akiang ah, "Toupa, huai Pa kou hon ensak in, huchi in kou a ding in ahun ding,” achi hi.
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Philip, hiai tanpi na kiang ah ka om a, huchi a leng hon thei lou maw? Kuapeuh kei hon mu tuh Pa mu ahi. Huai Pa kou hon musak in bangchi chih a na chih ahia?
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

paite: Kei Pa ah ka om a, keimah ah Pa a-om chih na gingta kei a hia? Na kiang ua thu ka gen, keimah phuahtawm in ka gen kei; keimah ah Pa a-om gige a, thil ahih zaw nak hi.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

paite: Kei Pa a ka omleh Pa keimah a a-om gingta un; ahihkeileh thilhih ziak bek in hon gingta un.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh hon gingta in ka thilhihte ahih sam ding; hiai sang a thupizaw leng ahih ding, Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

paite: Huan ka min a na nget peuhmah uh ka hih zel ding, Tapa a Pa pahtawi a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

paite: Nou ka min a bangpeuh na hon nget uleh, ka hih zel ding hi," achi hi.
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

paite: "Nou na hon it uleh, ka thupiakte na zui ding uhi.
heading: Kha Siangthou Chiamna
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

paite: Huan Pa ka ngen dia, ama'n Khamuanpa dang ahon pe ding, tangtawn a na kiang ua om ding in;
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

paite: huai thutak Kha; khovel in aneih theih louh ahi, amah amuh louh a, atheih louh behlap ziak in; nou amah na thei ua, na kiang uah a-om gige ngal a, noumau sung ah a-om ding hi.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

paite: "Tagah ding in ka hon paisan kei ding; na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding hi.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

paite: Sawt louchik sung khovel in ahon mu nawn kei ding; himahleh nou zaw na hon mu ding uh; keimah ka hin ziak in nou leng na hing sam ding uhi.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

paite: Huai ni chiang in kei ka Pa a ka om leh nou keimah a na om bang un, kei noumau a ka omdan na thei ding uhi.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

paite: "Kuapeuh ka thupiakte nei a, zui tuh kei hon it ahi; kuapeuh kei hon it ka Pa'n a-it ding, ke'n leng amah ka it ding a, akiang ah ka hihna ka kilak ding," achi hi.
english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

paite: Huan Judas, Iskariot lou pen in akiang ah, "Toupa, koute kiang a na kilak a, khovel kiang a na kilak louh se ding bangziak ahia?" achi hi.
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Mi'n ahon itleh ka thute azui ding a; ka Pa'n amah a-it dia, akiang ah ka hong pai ding ua, amah toh ka tengkhawm gige ding uhi.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

paite: Kuapeuh hon itlou in ka thu azui kei; na thuzakte uh kei a ahi kei a, Pa hon sawlpa a ahi zaw.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

paite: "Na kiang ua ka om takdih sung in, hiai thute ka hon hilh ahi.
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

paite: Khamuanpa, Kha Siangthou, Pa in ka min a hon sawl ding in bangkim nou ahon sinsak ding a, na kiang ua ka gen tengteng nou ahon theikhesak nawn lai ding.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

paite: "Khamuanna ka hon nutsiat hi; keimah khamuanna ka hon pia; khovel in apiak bang in ka hon pe kei. Na lungtang uh hihmangbat in om kei hen, lauh leng lau kei hen.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

paite: Ka paimang ding a, na kiang uah ka hong pai nawn ding, ka hon chih omdan na theita uh. Nou na hon it uh leh Pa kiang a ka pai ding ziak in na kipak ding uh ahi; keimah sang in Pa athupizaw ngal a.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

paite: Tu in hiai thil ahong tun chiang a na gintak theihna ding un ahong tun ma in ka hon hilh ahi.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

paite: Na kiang uah thu ka gen tam nawn kei ding, khovel vaihawmpa ahong pai dek ziak in; ama'n keimah ah bangmah anei kei hi.
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

paite: Himahleh ke'n Pa ka it chih leh Pa in hon thupiak bang zel in thil ka hih chih, khovel in atheihna ding uh ahi ve. Dingh dih ua, hiai a kipan i paikhe ding uh.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.
